headline: Sensex Rises 400 Points, Nifty Holds Above 23,200 Ahead of Fed Outcome
why: Investors awaiting key monetary policy decisions from the US Fed and BOJ
Rebound from day's low driven by gains in M&M, HDFC Life, FMCG, and Media stocks
Positive sentiment across major Asian markets like China and Hong Kong tech stocks
Resilience in benchmark indices despite underperformance in SMIDs and bond market concerns
whatHappening: Government policy updates around UPI MDR trigger significant moves in fintech, payment, and cash management stocks like Paytm and CMS Info Systems
Gold and silver prices record sharp rallies globally ahead of upcoming central bank rate decisions
